proceeding: Electronic Application of Kentucky Utilities Company for an Adjustment of its Electric Rates and Approval of Certain Regulatory and Accounting Treatments (filed jointly with Case No. 2025-00114, Louisville Gas & Electric Company)
how_obtained: Downloaded the PDF with curl from the Kentucky PSC public electronic case filing path (psc.ky.gov/pscecf/...), which serves case documents without a login. Extracted text with PyMuPDF using sorted-block extraction (page.get_text('text', sort=True)) so margin line numbers stay on the line they number. Pages joined with a form feed (\x0c). No cleaning, reflow, de-hyphenation or whitespace normalisation. OCR noise in the scanned signature and notary blocks is left exactly as extracted.
document_title: Joint Written Direct Testimony and Exhibits of Lane Kollen on behalf of the Office of the Attorney General and Kentucky Industrial Utility Customers
filer: Kentucky Office of the Attorney General, Office of Rate Intervention, jointly with Kentucky Industrial Utility Customers (KIUC)
notes: 378 pages: testimony plus exhibit schedules. Page 95 refers to 'Brown BESS'; the 2025-09-30 corrected version changes every such reference to 'Cane Run BESS'. The notarised affidavit page carries scanner OCR noise (stray glyphs around the signature) which is preserved.
